name: Student Permit (E-1)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an enrollment/admission letter from an officially registered Dominican educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a registered school or university.

requirements.blocker_text: A Student Visa (category E), valid 1 year with multiple entries, must be obtained at a Dominican consulate before entry.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the E visa at a Dominican consulate.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of financial solvency and valid medical insurance approved by migration authorities.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial solvency and approved medical insurance
Medical exam from a DGM-authorized institution

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable annually up to 6 years

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Student Permit (E-1): enrollment requirement, financial solvency, medical insurance, fees, 1-year renewable up to 6 years
MIREX Portal Único de Servicios de Relaciones Exteriores -- Student Visa (E): 1-year, multiple entries, university acceptance letter

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). The DGM page caps renewal at 6 years total -- a real, explicit ceiling worth flagging since most other countries' student routes in this dataset renew indefinitely alongside continued study. No work rights are granted on this permit per the source; this is a stricter no-work-at-all policy than many countries in this dataset that allow restricted part-time work for students.
